name: YONGTAI
recent: Yong Tai 的私募计划在延长截止日 2026 年 11 月 5 日到期后结束，公司决定不再配售剩余股份。同期，公司涉及一项重大诉讼，其子公司的一项裁决上诉被 Kerjaya Prospek 提出。最新财报显示营收大幅下滑且亏损扩大。
notable: 私募计划在延长截止日 2026 年 11 月 5 日到期后结束，公司决定不再配售剩余股份。
公司涉及重大诉讼，Kerjaya Prospek 就 Yong Tai 子公司的裁决提出上诉。
risks: 私募计划分阶段配售新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
公司涉及重大诉讼，且对方提出上诉。
最新季度营收同比大幅下降 77.2%，净亏损扩大。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度，营收为 MYR 1.887 million，环比下降 78.3%，同比下降 77.2%；净亏损为 MYR 6.779 million，净亏损率为 359.2%，较上一季度的 23.5% 扩大。

recent_en: Yong Tai's private placement lapsed on 5 November 2026 after the extended deadline, with the company deciding not to place out the remaining shares. Meanwhile, the company is involved in material litigation, with Kerjaya Prospek appealing an adjudication decision involving a Yong Tai unit. The latest financial results show a sharp decline in revenue and a wider loss.
notable_en: The private placement lapsed on 5 November 2026 after the extended deadline, and the company decided not to place out the remaining shares.
The company is involved in material litigation, with Kerjaya Prospek appealing an adjudication decision involving a Yong Tai unit.
risks_en: The private placement involved phased issuance of new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in material litigation, and the counterparty has filed an appeal.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 77.2% year-on-year, and net loss widened.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1.887 million, down 78.3% QoQ and 77.2% YoY; net loss was MYR 6.779 million with a net margin of -359.2%, wider than -23.5% in the previous quarter.
